name: Cigna

internationalCoverage.overview: Cigna (now The Cigna Group / Cigna Healthcare) has one of the strongest international networks among US carriers. Cigna Global operates as a dedicated international health insurance division with over 1.5 million healthcare professionals in 200+ countries. Many Cigna employer plans include meaningful international coverage.

planDifferences.description: PPO plans (especially Open Access Plus) provide good international coverage for emergency and urgent care at out-of-network rates. HMO plans cover emergencies only. Cigna's Global Health Benefits plans (for employers with international employees) offer comprehensive worldwide coverage.

covered: Urgent care (PPO and Open Access Plus plans)
Medical evacuation and repatriation (many employer plans)
24/7 health information line with multilingual support
notCovered: Routine care or wellness visits abroad
Dental and vision internationally (unless on a global plan)
Prescription medications from non-US pharmacies (standard plans)

alerts.title: Cigna Global Advantage
alerts.message: Cigna's international network is genuinely strong. They have direct billing agreements with major hospitals worldwide, which means less out-of-pocket upfront costs compared to other carriers. Ask about direct billing before you travel.

alerts.title: 24/7 Multilingual Support
alerts.message: Call Cigna's international assistance line for help finding providers, translation assistance, and claims guidance. Available 24/7 in multiple languages.

alerts.title: Cigna vs Cigna Global
alerts.message: Standard US Cigna plans and Cigna Global are different products. Make sure you know which you have — Cigna Global provides comprehensive worldwide coverage, while standard domestic plans have limitations abroad.

supplementalInsurance.details: Less critical for Cigna PPO members than most carriers. Cigna's international infrastructure is among the best. However, if you have a standard HMO plan or travel frequently to remote areas, supplemental coverage is still smart.

questionsToAsk: Do I have standard Cigna or Cigna Global coverage?
Is international emergency care covered at in-network or out-of-network rates?
Does my plan include medical evacuation and repatriation?
Can I access direct billing at international hospitals?
What's Cigna's international assistance phone number for my plan?
Are there coverage caps for international emergency care?
